question:
(a) Define current gain $\beta$ of a transistor in common-emitter configuration.
(b) The collector current changes from $3.0\,\text{mA}$ to $7.5\,\text{mA}$ when the base current changes from $30\,\mu\text{A}$ to $75\,\mu\text{A}$. Calculate $\beta$.

options.B:
(a) In common-emitter configuration, $\beta=\dfrac{\Delta I_C}{\Delta I_B}$ at constant collector-emitter voltage.
(b) $\Delta I_C=7.5-3.0=4.5\,\text{mA}$ and $\Delta I_B=75-30=45\,\mu\text{A}$. Thus $\beta=\dfrac{4.5\times10^{-3}}{45\times10^{-6}}=100$.
